form.description: code_fix: repair existing behaviour; feature: new behaviour or page; test_suite: the deliverable is a test suite; fix_and_report: investigate, report fields and fix source; answer_only: only submit.json fields, no source change; report_only: incident report, source changes out of scope

summary.description: one or two sentences: what has to be delivered

grading.description: every scoring mechanism the item or MVS states, one entry per rule; expected values, acceptance criteria and general info (maximum score) are not grading rules

aspect.description: mvs_replay: organizers rerun the issued MVS test; hidden_tests: organizer tests on the submitted source; browser_replay: a scenario is replayed in a browser on the built app; team_tests_pass: the team's own tests are run and must pass; detection: the team's tests are run against broken builds and must fail there; typecheck: the type check is graded; exact_fields: reported fields are compared exactly; completion_order: points depend on finishing order or time; existing_tests: issued tests must keep passing; zero_condition: a condition that makes the item score 0 (a file that does not validate, a missing or oversized deliverable); evidence_rule: a rule about how evidence must look (format, viewport, cited paths); other: any other scoring mechanism

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

sourceFiles.description: source files the item names explicitly; [] when it names none

path.description: path the item names, as written

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

testLocation.description: directory or file pattern the item requires for new tests, or null

answerFields.description: fields of submit.json the team must fill, besides status, evidenceFiles, testResults and the engineering/incident record

exact.description: true when the item says the field is compared exactly

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

evidence.description: every evidence file the item or its MVS requires by name

scenario.description: the testResults id this file proves (e.g. CR-07-TC-03), or null when the item requires it outside a scenario

file.description: file name under answers/<ID>/evidence/, exactly as required

beforeFix.description: true when it must be captured on the unfixed code

minViewport.description: minimum capture size WIDTHxHEIGHT the item states for this screenshot (e.g. 1280x720), or null

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

scenarios.description: every testResults id of the template, [] when the template has none

constraints.description: things the item forbids or fixes (keep handler names, tests in new files, out of scope...)

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

dependsOn.description: other backlog items whose fix this item needs

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

zeroConditions.description: size limits and required files that make the item score 0 when not met, as the item states them; [] when it states none

kind.description: max_size: a file or directory must stay under a size; required_file: a file must exist; other: any other condition that zeroes the item

path.description: file or directory the condition is about, relative, as the item writes it; null when it names none

maxBytes.description: size limit in bytes for max_size (20 MB = 20971520), else null

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

investigation.description: main source the cause or the figures must be found in

needsRunningApp.description: evidence or a scenario needs the built app running

officialData.description: figures must come from the official test data replayed on the fixed source
